composition_label: Customer insights -> Semantic search -> Document review -> Guided setup

construction.implementation_origin: New, self-contained implementation authored for this isolated build.

input.requirements: {id, description, required_terms: [single-word string], min_evidence?: positive integer}

shared_schema.output: {schema_version, status: ok, synthetic, stages: {insights, semantic, review, guided}}
shared_schema.error: {schema_version, status: error, error: string}; exit code 2
shared_schema.validation: One Validation class checks input shapes, unknown keys, types, finite numbers, unique IDs, references, cycles, vectors, and stage provenance before each downstream handoff.
shared_schema.bounds: CLI file limit 2 MB; collections <=500; text <=12000 characters; themes <=30; top_k <=50; embedding dimensions <=4096.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated theme keyword queries with original feedback IDs.
Only retrieved ranked document bodies and query IDs become review candidates; unretrieved documents cannot support requirements.
Validated supported/gap statuses gate requirement-linked setup steps; blockers retain requirement IDs.

behavior.insights: Domain-neutral keyword-frequency themes; document-frequency counting over feedback; explicit ignored feedback and truncation counts; heuristic positive/negative/mixed/neutral sentiment and investigation actions.
behavior.semantic: In-memory inverted index; deterministic TF-IDF cosine relevance ranking, stable document-ID tie breaks, threshold and top-k limits. Optional injected callable adds weighted cosine similarity. No embedding provider is built in.
behavior.embedding_contract: run_pipeline(input_dict, embedder=callable): one list of query/document texts -> equal-count list of finite, nonzero, same-dimension numeric vectors. Synthetic fixture callables only.
behavior.review: All required words must occur in a single retrieved document body. Unique supporting documents count toward min_evidence. Evidence has exact character offsets, quotes, matched terms, document IDs, and query IDs. Gaps include per-candidate missing terms and evidence shortfall.
behavior.guided: Acyclic prerequisite graph; deterministic topological order; ready/blocked/completed states; supplied completions must satisfy both prerequisites and reviewed evidence. Progress is derived from the input snapshot and returned as JSON. No hidden state.
behavior.empty_input: Empty arrays accepted. No feedback yields no retrieval; unsatisfied requirements yield gaps. Zero onboarding steps means 100 percent complete.
behavior.cli: One JSON object on stdout. Success exits 0. File, JSON, encoding, size, and validation errors exit 2. Duplicate JSON keys and non-finite constants rejected.

excluded: Semantic entailment, negation reasoning, or truth verification
Multilingual stemming and synonym inference without an injected embedding

coverage: Synthetic injected embeddings and malformed vectors

cli_example.stdout: One parseable JSON object with status ok and four ordered stages
